name: Speaker 8 Ω 0.5 W (28 mm round)
description: Small round speaker for voice and sounds. Drive it from an amplifier: the DFPlayer Mini's SPK_1 (+) and SPK_2 (-), or an I2S amplifier's OUT+ / OUT- (MAX98357A); never straight from a board pin (8 Ω would pull 600 mA). Not polarised for sound, but keep + / - the same when you use two.

pins.description: Speaker lead +. To the amplifier output + (DFPlayer SPK_1, MAX98357A OUT+).
Speaker lead -. To the amplifier output - (DFPlayer SPK_2, MAX98357A OUT-; neither is ground).

props.label: Impedance
props.description: Coil impedance. The DFPlayer drives 4 or 8 Ω; 8 Ω is quieter but kinder to a battery.

props.label: Rated power
props.description: What the speaker takes continuously before it distorts or burns.

footprint: 28 mm round frame, two solder tabs (wires)

bindings.description: Something plays through it (more than 1 mW).
Electrical power into the coil (W, RMS).
RMS voltage across the leads (+ minus -).

mechanical.source: typical 28 mm 8 Ω 0.5 W mylar speaker, 5 mm deep

sourcing.package: 28 mm round, 5 mm deep, solder tabs
sourcing.generic: Mini speaker 28 mm, 8 Ω, 0.5 W (mylar cone)
